info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Telecom Sim Esim Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM eSIM Status API provides access to the current status of telecom SIM and eSIM devices. This endpoint allows users to efficiently retrieve status information in bulk, making it ideal for telecom providers and application developers looking to monitor device readiness and availability. Customers can query the status to ensure devices are operational and manage their inventory effectively. Typical use cases include integration with inventory management systems and status dashboards.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to retrieve the current status of the eSIM. It provides information about activation, provisioning, and any potential issues related to the eSIM functionality.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of the eSIM associated with the SIM card. It should be tailored to include necessary parameters that indicate the specific SIM or eSIM for which the status is being requested.

200.description: The request was successful and the current eSIM status is returned.

ListTelecomSimEsimStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to the status of the SIM eSIM. It is expected to be a string value.

ListTelecomSimEsimStatusResponse_200.title: ESIM Operations Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the operation.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the operation took to process.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListTelecomSimEsimStatusResponse_200.description: This schema represents the response structure for the ESIM operations GET request.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: This schema represents the auditing details of the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. A value of 0 indicates that the processing time was negligible.
